task_description: Implement Phase 0.4 - Dashboard MVP (kernd). A single-binary VPS daemon that manages kern app deployments: admin web UI, git-based deploy worker, process manager, reverse proxy with host-header routing, cgroup v2 resource isolation, log capture, and backup system.

verification.summary: Build with zero warnings. All 36 tests pass (30 original + 6 new kernd tests). Tests exercise real code paths: config loading with temp TOML files, app registry CRUD with in-memory SQLite, process fork/exec/stop with /bin/sleep, vhost table operations, cgroup graceful fallback, and backup tar.gz creation/pruning with temp directories.
